risk_summary: The disclosure presents a cyclical, commodity-sensitive business exposed to declining prices, reduced customer spending, competition, labor-cost pressure, and international operating risks. It provides some useful quantified revenue, expense, contract, and activity information, but relies materially on forward-looking beliefs and generalized expectations regarding market recovery and horizontal-well maintenance growth.
